scope: Local behavioral tests using Apps Script service doubles and actual compiled frontend adapter. Google deployment and in-browser Google Sites embedding require installation by the owner.
results: No access or data before owner setup
Setup creates private data store with source catalogs and safe samples
Repeated setup preserves rows and does not create another spreadsheet
Blank visitor identity cannot inherit deployment owner privileges
Unapproved signed-in account cannot read or write
Invalid types, missing fields, quantity limits and unknown occupations are rejected
Create demand and capacity; reload reads persisted Sheets rows
Proposal reduces available quantities and survives reload
Reject mismatched occupation, level, period, missing IDs, reversed roles
Capacity limit and demand limit both apply on the server
Concurrent update is re-read after acquiring the shared lock
Busy lock produces retry response without saving
User text remains text and spoofed IDs/sample flags are replaced
Reports preserve quarter separation, skill gaps, searchable catalog, safe CSV
Missing source sheet fails visibly instead of inventing real data
Manifest defaults to owner-only deployment and contains no external connection scope
Company and school lookup, original codes and prefilled forms remain available
Frontend reads all three endpoints through google.script.run
Embedded save requires typed review code before any RPC write
Cancelling embedded save keeps data out of the backend
Offline preview remains read-only and clearly rejects save
Missing Apps Script connection and malformed JSON fail with visible errors
Apps Script communication failure preserves a retryable response
Index and preview are standalone, have correct heading and valid inline JavaScript
